critical_code_review_comments: server.pick_unit assigns the first alphabetically-sorted free unit_id (GR-008 then GR-009), excluding bookings in pending_payment/confirmed that overlap [start,end). Cancellation sets status='cancelled' which exits the busy filter -> freed unit; verified reassignment to the lowest free id. Overlap test uses $lt/$gt which correctly treats same-day boundaries as non-overlapping; appropriate here because end timestamps are T19:00 vs next-day T09:00.

server.admin_sheet_script_url validates URL with a strict regex then calls sheet_writer.ping; ping posts {action:'ping',token:SHEET_SCRIPT_TOKEN} and expects the Apps Script to answer {error:'unknown action'} -> true. For an unregistered URL (abc) Google returns an HTML error page so .json() raises and ping returns False -> HTTPException(400) as expected. Behavior under rate-limit / unexpected 2xx HTML is also safe (returns False).

server.admin_sheet_script injects SHEET_SCRIPT_TOKEN into the apps_script.gs template by regex-replacing the placeholder token; two file reads could be collapsed into one but is harmless. The returned payload also includes the currently linked write URL (empty when not set) so the UI can toggle 'Attivo' state.

sheet_sync.parse_models uses _category() which strips non-alpha then checks substrings: 'E-gravel' -> 'egravel' (starts with e, contains gravel), 'E-bike MTB' -> 'ebike_mtb' (contains mtb). Returns {} and warns silently when the Modelli tab is missing or has no 'Modello'+'Categoria' header -> safe default.

sheet_writer.push_booking only writes app-sourced confirmed bookings (not sheet-sourced); on first append it stores the returned sheet_id onto the booking and deletes any racing sheet-copy. Flow is non-blocking via asyncio.create_task from POST /bookings and PATCH /admin/bookings.

Frontend sheet-link.tsx surfaces backend HTTPException.detail as the inline sheet-link-error -> both IT and EN translations propagate correctly; the save button is disabled until url.trim().length>=10 which prevents the 422 'min_length' Pydantic path for most inputs.
